info.title: Queue OpenAPI for bria/fibo-2/edit
info.description:
Fibo 2.0 Edit is Bria's image editing model for background changes, product restaging, campaign adaptations, and reference-guided variations. Bria states that the model is trained on licensed data.

The endpoint accepts one to four images in image_urls: the source image first, followed by up to three references. Instructions can refer to them as <image_1>, <image_2>, and so on. Free-form instructions are expanded into a VGL document, which is returned with the edited image and can be reused directly.

Single-image requests keep the source aspect ratio. An optional mask marks the area to regenerate in white and the area to preserve in black; it must match the source image size. Masked output retains the source dimensions and the original pixels outside the mask. Masks are supported only with a single image.

Multi-image requests support 21 output aspect ratios at approximately one megapixel. Left unset, the output keeps the first image's aspect ratio. A seed controls reproducibility, and sync mode returns the image directly in the response.

For generation from a text prompt, use Fibo 2.0 Generate.

instruction.title: Instruction
examples: Create a luxury fragrance poster by placing the perfume bottle from <image_2> upright on the grey boulder in the misty water from <image_3>, and add the minimalist typography from <image_1> in the upper sky.
instruction.description: The edit, in free-form text. It is expanded into a VGL, which is returned. With 'vgl', the change to make to it. 'prompt' is accepted as an alias.

vgl.title: Vgl
vgl.description: A VGL (Visual Generation Language) document. Alone, it is the edit as-is and must carry its 'edit_instruction'. With 'instruction', it is the first image's VGL, the baseline the edit is written from. Accepts what a previous request returned.

sync_mode.title: Sync Mode
sync_mode.description: If true, returns the image directly in the response (increases latency).

aspect_ratio.title: Aspect Ratio
aspect_ratio.description: Output aspect ratio, at about one megapixel. Left unset, the output keeps the ratio of the first image. A single image always keeps its own ratio.

image_urls.title: Image Urls
image_urls.description: 1-4 images to edit (files or URLs). The instruction refers to them as <image_1>, <image_2> and so on, in the order they are sent.

mask_url.title: Mask Url
mask_url.description: Mask (file or URL) marking the region to regenerate: white where the model should edit, black elsewhere. Single-image requests only, at that image's size. A masked edit comes back at the image's own size, with its own pixels outside the mask.

images.title: Images
images.description: Single-element list holding the same image, as the sibling FIBO apps return.
